title: Label email mentions: ghost batch 2
description:

Files:
- `ghost/core/core/server/services/members/api.js`

## Setup

```
git fetch origin
git checkout -b label/KDATAP-e07d03 origin/kdatap-46d893-labeling-base
pnpm install
pnpm run benchmark:materialize ghost
```

1. `.agents/skills/curate-scanner-evaluation-corpus/references/mention-attribute-labeling.md`
2. The worked example it points to: `tests/benchmark/repos/ghost/annotations/packets/example-ghost-batch-3.yaml`

## Do

- Input: the entries for the files above in `tests/benchmark/repos/ghost/annotations/packets/email-candidates.yaml`.
- Read each file from `tests/benchmark/.cache/repos/ghost@73612b18663c0145dcca8611904b7f21b5f84552/`, with the surrounding code for every candidate line.
- Write exactly one record per candidate line to `tests/benchmark/repos/ghost/annotations/packets/KDATAP-e07d03.yaml`, with `packet.kanbus_issue: KDATAP-e07d03`, `packet.files` equal to the files above, and `review_state: proposed`.

## Rules

- Do not run the scanner or read scanner output, `annotations/mentions.yaml`, or other packets.
- Uncertain: `status: ambiguous` with a one-sentence rationale. Do not guess.
- Do not edit any file except your packet and `annotations/KDATAP-e07d03/pass.md`.
- Do not assert `touches` or `group`.

## Finish

1. `pnpm run benchmark:validate-packet tests/benchmark/repos/ghost/annotations/packets/KDATAP-e07d03.yaml` prints `OK`.
2. Record the pass in `annotations/KDATAP-e07d03/pass.md`: files, record count, positive / negative / ambiguous counts, and anything you were unsure about.
3. Commit both files on `label/KDATAP-e07d03`. The coordinator reviews, then moves this issue to awaiting-review.
